purpose: Actual 2-peer WebRTC lockstep soak; isolate local input-preview cost under a 500-unit shared-world fixture
environment: Headless Chromium / SwiftShader WebGL, two independent tabs, local signed relay fixture, actual WebRTC data channels, 500 static test units plus players, 8-second real-time hold
method: Sequential single run per condition on the same game/SDK source. Preview-off is a test-response-only override. Both conditions keep the public session in lockstep and verify same-tick canonical checkpoint bytes across peers. No public relay, STUN/NAT, Android hardware or rollback-mode RTC.

previousFullValidationPreviewOn.measurement: Earlier single run with the same 500-unit two-peer fixture and GameKit dist, before the prediction-only fast install path.

limitations: One sequential sample per condition; not a reversed-order or statistically repeated A/B.
The headless two-tab RAF counter advanced only 1-2 frames during the hold and is not a usable mobile FPS result.
Preview-on remains below the 10 TPS target; this does not justify enabling rollback.
Preview-off is a diagnostic control, not a proposed product setting.
